headline: US Sees Indonesia as Having Opportunity to Get Investment Scheme Like the Philippines' LEC
summary: The United States considers Indonesia to have an opportunity to obtain an infrastructure investment scheme like the Luzon Economic Corridor in the Philippines. The report says this could come through expanding existing cooperation.
why: Economic corridor schemes bundle infrastructure spending with private and foreign investment, affecting construction, logistics and capital flows into the host country.
